notice: Fictional code written from scratch for a software demo. It is not a real building code and gives no legal advice.

rules.title: Owner signature
rules.text: The property owner signs the application before review starts.

rules.title: Parcel number format
rules.text: The application names the parcel in the form LH-0000-000.

rules.title: Who builds
rules.text: The application names a contractor with a city license number in the form LHC-00000, or states that the owner builds the work.

rules.title: Stated value of work
rules.text: The application states the value of the work in dollars, and the value is more than zero.

rules.title: Residential district
rules.text: Work under this code takes place on a lot in district R1, R2 or R3.

rules.title: Front setback
rules.text: New work stays back from the front lot line by at least 25 ft in R1, 20 ft in R2 and 15 ft in R3.

rules.title: Side setback
rules.text: New work stays back from each side lot line by at least 8 ft in R1, 6 ft in R2 and 5 ft in R3.

rules.title: Rear setback
rules.text: New work stays back from the rear lot line by at least 20 ft in R1, 15 ft in R2 and 10 ft in R3.

rules.title: Lot coverage
rules.text: The existing footprint plus the new area covers no more than 40 percent of the lot.

rules.title: Height of an addition
rules.text: An addition is no taller than 30 ft, measured from grade to the highest point of the roof.

rules.title: Deck size for standard review
rules.text: A deck reviewed on the standard path has no more than 500 sq ft of floor area. A larger deck needs an engineered review.

rules.title: Guard height
rules.text: When the walking surface of a deck is more than 24 in above grade, a guard runs along each open side and stands at least 38 in tall.

rules.title: Guard openings
rules.text: When a guard is required by LHRC 12.2.1, no opening in it is wider than 3.5 in.

rules.title: Stair riser height
rules.text: Each stair riser on a deck stair is no taller than 7.5 in.

rules.title: Stair tread depth
rules.text: Each stair tread on a deck stair is at least 10.5 in deep.

rules.title: Handrail on longer stairs
rules.text: A deck stair with four or more risers has a handrail.

rules.title: Joist spacing
rules.text: Deck joists sit no more than 16 in apart, measured center to center.

rules.title: Footing depth
rules.text: The bottom of each deck footing sits at least 30 in below grade.

rules.title: Ledger attachment
rules.text: A deck ledger fastens to the house with bolts or lag screws. Nails alone are not enough. A freestanding deck needs no ledger.

rules.title: Addition size for standard review
rules.text: An addition reviewed on the standard path adds no more than 900 sq ft of floor area.

rules.title: Ceiling height
rules.text: Habitable rooms in an addition have a ceiling at least 84 in high.

rules.title: Escape window in new bedrooms
rules.text: Each new bedroom has a window that a person can climb out of in an emergency.

rules.title: Smoke alarm
rules.text: An addition has at least one smoke alarm wired to the house system.

rules.title: Number of stories
rules.text: An addition has no more than two stories above grade.

rules.title: Foundation type
rules.text: An addition rests on a slab, a crawlspace or a basement foundation. Piers alone need an engineered review.
